en.heading: What I work on
en.intro: Three kinds of claim are made about a model after post-training: that a score measures a capability, that an internal direction is a concept, and that a training gain came from what was trained. Each cheaper mechanism that could produce the same number gets its own control arm.

themes.title: Evaluation validity and leakage control
themes.body: When a reported score measures the protocol, a look-ahead, or a controlled split rather than the capability.

themes.title: Mechanistic interpretability
themes.body: Whether a probe or a steering direction measures the concept it is named for, or a cheaper correlate such as lexical overlap.

themes.title: Alignment and safety
themes.body: Which properties a post-training run installs, which it only appears to, and what evidence tells the two apart.

en.outro: The evaluation layer is the four accepted papers above. The training layer runs at pilot scale: under 200 preference pairs per adapter, one algorithm, one A100. Raising that half to research scale is what the PhD is for.

zh.heading: 我在做什么
zh.intro: 后训练之后，人们对一个模型会做三种声称：一个分数度量了一项能力，一个内部方向就是一个概念，一次训练增益来自训练的内容。每一种能给出同一个数字的更廉价机制，各配一条对照臂。

themes.title: 评测效度与泄漏控制
themes.body: 当一个被报告的分数量的是协议、前视泄漏或受控子集，而不是能力。

themes.title: 机制可解释性
themes.body: 一个探针或一个引导方向，量的是它所命名的概念，还是词面重叠这类更廉价的相关物。

themes.title: 对齐与安全
themes.body: 一次后训练装进了哪些属性，哪些只是看起来装进了，什么证据能把两者分开。

zh.outro: 评估层是上面四篇已录用论文。训练层停在 pilot 规模：每个适配器不到 200 个偏好对、一种算法、一张 A100。把这一半提到研究级，就是读博的目的。
